entry_item.definition: adv. Well, nicely, appropriately; thoroughly, duly.

example.definition: To understand very well, realize fully

entry_item.definition: T. rnam par, nye bar, rab (tu). Translates often 'the S. prefixes vi-, upa-, pra-in an intensifying meaning

example.definition: T. rab tu sgom ba; S. prabhāvanā. Profound concentration
T. rnam par smin pa; S.vipāka. Maturation (of deeds), fruition, the arrival of just deserts.
T. rabtu hjoms pa; S. pramardana. Destruction
T. rab tu hbyin pa; To admit into the clerical order.
T. rab (tu) byung (ba); S. pravrajyā . Going forth (to the religious life). ED 387b. pravrājayati.
T. legs (par) bcad (pa), legs (par) gsung (ba); S. subhāshita. Well-explained, well-stated (a characteristic of Buddhist doctrine).
T. rab tu gnas pa; S. supratishthita. 'Well established,' consecrated (as an image). See rabnai
T. legs par bsnyen pa rdzogs pa; S. sūpasampanna. Fully ordained
T. rnam par rig pa; S. vijnapti. Representation, esp. in the term vijnapti-matra (representation only). Different : ED 485 b.
T. nye bar bstan pa; S. upadeça. Explanation, exegesis; a branch of Scripture.ED 135a
